name: realm-bench-PlanarDet
description: PlanarDet in the realm-bench collection evaluates models on detecting and localizing planar surfaces and planar-structured objects in images, using annotated images with bounding boxes and/or masks. It measures object detection and segmentation performance focused on planar geometry and layout understanding.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) / IoU-based detection metrics
reputation: Part of the realm-bench suite on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among vision researchers interested in geometric/planar detection.
